privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: real2block turns a photo of a person into a Minecraft skin and a paper figure. A photo is personal data, so the service is built to remember nothing about you.
privacy.processed.title: What is processed
privacy.processed.photo: The photo you upload. It is processed only in the memory of our server and only after you consent.
privacy.processed.face: The position of the face and five points on it (eyes, nose, mouth corners), to know where to take colors from.
privacy.processed.colors: The colors of skin, hair, eyes, mouth and clothes.
privacy.processed.faceFront: For the “Like the photo” style, an 8×8 pixel copy of the face. The photo cannot be restored from it.
privacy.processed.skin: The generated skin or the PNG skin you upload, to make the preview and the PDF.
privacy.notDone.title: What we do not do
privacy.notDone.identify: We do not recognize who you are and do not estimate age, gender or ethnicity.
privacy.notDone.external: We do not send the photo to third-party services: everything runs on our server.
privacy.notDone.trackers: We use no analytics, trackers, cookies or browser storage.
privacy.storage.title: How long it is kept
privacy.storage.zero: Retention is zero. The photo, the skin and the PDF are never saved to disk, temporary files or a cache, and are forgotten right after the response.
privacy.storage.logs: Technical logs hold only a request number, the API route, the status, the response time, the file size and error codes. No file names, photo metadata or IP addresses.
privacy.storage.ip: To limit the request rate, the IP address is turned into a hash with a secret salt and kept only in server memory.
privacy.consent.title: Consent
privacy.consent.body: A photo is processed only if you tick the consent box before uploading. A ready PNG skin can be uploaded without a photo.
